# ex: assigneeType for map index expression
ex {
	var x int
	x + 0 -> x
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(m map[int]string) string {
	return m[1+0]
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 package m

-	return m[1+0]
+	return m[1]
 }
